From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>

Subject: Customer perf deep-dive: scheduling & runbook prep (NimbusAI)

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Nimbus's engineering team asked for a focused performance deep-dive to align on:
- target token throughput and 95th/99th latency SLOs for the pilot
- planned load-test topology (dedicated vs. burst) and model variants to test
- any data-handling constraints and audit log requirements

Can we book a 60-min session next week to run through the architecture and the load-test plan? Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue 10/13 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 10/14 09:00–10:00 or 16:00–17:00

If those don't work, send your preferred times and we will try to accommodate. I'll attach a concise benchmark plan and perf matrix so we can walk through concrete targets.

Agenda I suggest:
1) Quick context & success metrics (10m)
2) Architecture & routing + hardware profile (20m)
3) Load-test plan and pass/fail criteria (20m)
4) Next steps / actions (10m)

Markus and Karthik will join to cover runtime knobs and quantization options.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: benchmark-plan-v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

Thanks Tessa — this is great. We definitely want to do the 60-min deep-dive. Our engineers prefer Wed 10/14 09:00–10:00 PT (that hits early afternoon for our EU folks).

Couple quick asks so we come prepared:
- Can you confirm the model variant(s) you'll demo? (we have internal constraints on quantization levels)
- We have a target of 350 tokens/sec sustained per shard and 95th latency target of < 120ms for the pilot — can you confirm Redwood can reproduce similar load profiles?

I attached a short availability sheet and will send a calendar invite once we lock the time.

Samira

+1 on Wed 10/14 09:00 PT. Quick internal notes to align before the call: 
- Proposed model variants: rdx-3b-int8 and rdx-7b-qp8 (we should show rdx-3b-int8 for sustained throughput, rdx-7b-qp8 for latency tradeoffs)
- Hardware we intend to provision for the demo: 4x A100-equivalent instances (shared cluster) with continuous batching enabled
- Target test passes: sustained 300–400 tokens/sec per shard (adjustable), peak 600 tokens/sec burst for stress case, 95th < 120ms

I've updated the benchmark plan with a perf matrix and a short checklist (attached). Laura — can you add the trace knobs and the KV cache warm-start steps?

— Markus

- list of example prompt mixes (percentages of short/medium/long requests)

4) Runbook & load-test steps (20m)
